trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: This is the platinum, so it unlocks only after every other trophy on the list has been earned. Treat it as your final check rather than a task in itself: work through the story, completion and collectible requirements first, then confirm nothing is left unticked. No separate action is described for it beyond earning the other 54 trophies.
trophies.sources: Official PS5 trophy list via Exophase and PSNProfiles

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Play through the opening mission named Gone Fishing until it is marked complete. Because the description ties this directly to that first mission, simply starting the campaign and finishing its introductory sequence should earn it. If you skip cinematics, let the mission reach its completion screen before moving on.
trophies.sources: Official PS5 trophy list via Exophase and PSNProfiles

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Keep advancing the main campaign until Chapter 1 is finished. The description gives no optional objective, so this is a straightforward story-progress trophy earned by completing that chapter in order. No collectible or side activity is mentioned as part of the requirement.
trophies.sources: Official PS5 trophy list via Exophase and PSNProfiles

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Continue the main story through to the end of Chapter 2. Like the other chapter trophies, this one is awarded for campaign progress rather than for any optional task. Play the chapter missions in sequence and the trophy should register when the chapter closes.
trophies.sources: Official PS5 trophy list via Exophase and PSNProfiles

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Progress through the campaign until Chapter 3 is complete. Nothing in the description suggests a choice or a hidden condition, so following the story markers from mission to mission is the method. Expect it at the chapter completion point.
trophies.sources: Official PS5 trophy list via Exophase and PSNProfiles

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 4 of the main story. This is a pure progression trophy, so keep following the campaign objectives until the chapter ends. The description names no side content, so no detours are required for this one.
trophies.sources: Official PS5 trophy list via Exophase and PSNProfiles

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission of the campaign. This gold trophy marks the end of the main story, so it comes naturally after finishing every chapter that precedes it. The description does not confirm whether ending choices affect it, so keep a save before the finale if you want a safety net.
trophies.sources: Official PS5 trophy list via Exophase and PSNProfiles

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete the mission called Breakfast Run. Follow the story or mission marker for Breakfast Run and play it through to its completion screen. The description confirms only the mission name, so no extra location or method is stated beyond finishing that mission.
trophies.sources: Official PS5 trophy list via Exophase and PSNProfiles

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Complete the mission called The Cartel Heist. Heists in this series usually involve a setup and an execution phase, but the description confirms only that finishing this named mission is required. Play it through in the campaign and let it conclude normally.
trophies.sources: Official PS5 trophy list via Exophase and PSNProfiles

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete the mission called Child's Play. Advance the story until this mission becomes available, then finish it in full. The description gives no optional condition, so standard mission completion is the whole requirement.
trophies.sources: Official PS5 trophy list via Exophase and PSNProfiles

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete the mission called Headliners. Work through the campaign until Headliners appears, then finish the mission. Only the mission name is confirmed by the description, so treat any finer method as unconfirmed and simply complete the objective chain.
trophies.sources: Official PS5 trophy list via Exophase and PSNProfiles

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete the mission called VCIA Takedown. Follow the story to this mission and complete every objective until it ends. The description does not specify an approach such as stealth or combat, so either route that finishes the mission should count.
trophies.sources: Official PS5 trophy list via Exophase and PSNProfiles

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete the mission called Operation Savage Glory. This is a named story mission, so progress the campaign until it unlocks and then finish it. No optional or collectible condition is mentioned in the description.
trophies.sources: Official PS5 trophy list via Exophase and PSNProfiles

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100 percent completion as tracked by the game. That total typically combines story missions, activities, collectibles and exploration, and this guide's roadmap groups those requirements so you can chase them systematically. Use the in-game completion tracker to find your remaining percentage rather than guessing, since the description alone does not list every component.
trophies.sources: Official PS5 trophy list via Exophase and PSNProfiles

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Perform stunts until you have completed 250 of them. Look for stunt opportunities during free roam and races, and repeat varied stunt types as you travel rather than grinding them all at the end. The description confirms the total of 250 but does not name individual stunt locations, so rely on the in-game counter to track progress.
trophies.sources: Official PS5 trophy list via Exophase and PSNProfiles

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each type of activity at least once. The starter hint references nine activity types, so sample one of everything the map offers instead of specialising in a single pastime. Keep a personal note of which types you have sampled, because the description does not list them by name.
trophies.sources: Official PS5 trophy list via Exophase and PSNProfiles

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in every Shooting Range challenge. Practise each weapon category separately and replay challenges until your score, accuracy and time all meet the gold standard. The description confirms gold across all challenges is required; replaying is expected, so treat early attempts as learning runs.
trophies.sources: Official PS5 trophy list via Exophase and PSNProfiles

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location. Find each drone race start point, learn its route on a first attempt, then replay for the win before moving to the next location. Winning, not merely entering, is what the description requires at every location.
trophies.sources: Official PS5 trophy list via Exophase and PSNProfiles

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Enter a variety of race events across the map and aim for first place in twenty distinct ones, since repeats of the same race may not add to the distinct count. Mix vehicle classes so you are always entering a fresh event.
trophies.sources: Official PS5 trophy list via Exophase and PSNProfiles

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Find the fishing challenge involving Cal and outperform him under its rules, whether that is judged on catch size, weight or count. The description names the opponent and the activity but not the scoring detail, so read the challenge briefing in game before you start.
trophies.sources: Official PS5 trophy list via Exophase and PSNProfiles

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete one arcade game. Locate an arcade cabinet that offers a playable game and finish a full playthrough of it, rather than quitting mid-game. Only a single completed arcade game is required, making this one of the quickest trophies on the list.
trophies.sources: Official PS5 trophy list via Exophase and PSNProfiles

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission given by Andy. Work through Andy's mission strand from its first job to its last, since only the final mission triggers this trophy. If the strand stalls, progress the main story and return, as later missions often unlock in sequence.
trophies.sources: Official PS5 trophy list via Exophase and PSNProfiles

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission given by Kenton. Follow Kenton's strand through all of its missions until the concluding one is done. The description confirms the endpoint only, so keep accepting Kenton's jobs whenever they appear.
trophies.sources: Official PS5 trophy list via Exophase and PSNProfiles

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission given by Billy. Play Billy's strand from start to finish and complete its last mission. As with the other character strands, earlier missions must be cleared before the finale becomes available.
trophies.sources: Official PS5 trophy list via Exophase and PSNProfiles

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete eight mission strands for strangers across Leonida. Accept stranger encounters whenever they appear on the map and see each strand through, counting strands rather than individual missions. This silver trophy rewards breadth, so start strands early instead of leaving them all for the endgame.
trophies.sources: Official PS5 trophy list via Exophase and PSNProfiles

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission given by Randy. Progress Randy's strand to its conclusion and finish the last job. Keep an eye on your phone or map markers so the strand does not sit unfinished while you focus elsewhere.
trophies.sources: Official PS5 trophy list via Exophase and PSNProfiles

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission given by Tyrone. Work through Tyrone's missions in order until the final one is complete. The description confirms only the strand finale, so no special method is stated.
trophies.sources: Official PS5 trophy list via Exophase and PSNProfiles

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every meditation spot across Leonida. Visit each spot and use its meditate prompt, keeping track of districts you have already covered so none are missed. The description confirms spots are spread across the whole state, so combine the search with general exploration.
trophies.sources: Official PS5 trophy list via Exophase and PSNProfiles

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Take Bret's hunting request and track the specific unique animal it targets, rather than hunting common wildlife. The description does not name the species or its location, so follow Bret's in-game briefing for those details instead of assuming them.
trophies.sources: Official PS5 trophy list via Exophase and PSNProfiles

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete three full Collectible Card sets. Collect cards wherever you find them and check the set screen regularly to see which sets are closest to completion, then focus your searching there. Completing sets, not just gathering loose cards, is what the description counts.
trophies.sources: Official PS5 trophy list via Exophase and PSNProfiles

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Use the WAiNK It action at 100 locations. As you explore, use this interaction whenever a new eligible location offers it, and keep a running tally by district. The description confirms the total of 100 locations but does not define the action further, so follow the in-game prompt wherever it appears.
trophies.sources: Official PS5 trophy list via Exophase and PSNProfiles

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges. Work through the game's challenge lists as you play, favouring challenges that overlap with activities you are already doing for other trophies. Fifty is a cumulative total, so steady progress during the story beats a late grind.
trophies.sources: Official PS5 trophy list via Exophase and PSNProfiles

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner alongside you, reach a four-star Wanted Level and then lose it and escape. Build the wanted level together, then break line of sight and hide until the search ends without either of you being caught. Because it depends on a single continuous sequence with your partner present, treat a failed escape as a fresh attempt and set it up deliberately in free roam.
trophies.sources: Official PS5 trophy list via Exophase and PSNProfiles

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob three shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level in between. Plan a tight route between three nearby shops so the wanted level stays active throughout the chain, and leave each shop quickly. The back-to-back condition makes this sequence-sensitive, so rehearse the route once before attempting it for the trophy.
trophies.sources: Official PS5 trophy list via Exophase and PSNProfiles

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 different vehicles. Get into or register new vehicle models whenever you spot one you have not used, including parked cars in new districts. Variety matters more than ownership here, so sampling vehicles during exploration steadily builds the count.
trophies.sources: Official PS5 trophy list via Exophase and PSNProfiles

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down five enemies during a single use of Combat Focus. Wait until you are facing a group of at least five enemies, activate Combat Focus once, and focus fire quickly before it expires. Set the attempt up in a busy combat encounter rather than hoping it happens by chance.
trophies.sources: Official PS5 trophy list via Exophase and PSNProfiles

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA, the location also referenced by the VCIA Takedown mission. The description is deliberately vague about the exact method, so experiment with leaving that location outside its scripted sequence and watch for the trophy. Because the trigger is not confirmed by the description alone, do not assume a specific vehicle or exit is required.
trophies.sources: Official PS5 trophy list via Exophase and PSNProfiles

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: The description, 'Kinda hot in these Rhinos,' points to Rhino tanks but does not state a precise action. Expect an encounter involving Rhinos and engage with it when it occurs during missions or free roam. The exact unlock condition is not confirmed by the description alone, so no specific method is claimed here.
trophies.sources: Official PS5 trophy list via Exophase and PSNProfiles

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Approach quietly, avoid raising an alarm or being spotted, and leave with the loot while still undetected. Detection at any point breaks the condition described, so save beforehand and retry the same store if you are seen.
trophies.sources: Official PS5 trophy list via Exophase and PSNProfiles

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob five Bank Vaults and escape successfully each time. Treat each vault as its own heist: enter, take the money, and get clear of the police before counting it. Five successful escapes are required, so a robbery where you are caught should not be assumed to count.
trophies.sources: Official PS5 trophy list via Exophase and PSNProfiles

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an Armored Truck and escape. Find an armored truck in free roam, force access to its cargo, take the money and lose the heat afterwards. Only one successful truck robbery with an escape is described, so a single clean job should be enough.
trophies.sources: Official PS5 trophy list via Exophase and PSNProfiles

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida. Travel into every district and sub-area, including places the story never sends you, until the map counts as fully explored. Pair this with collectible hunting so remote areas are visited once and covered thoroughly.
trophies.sources: Official PS5 trophy list via Exophase and PSNProfiles

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang. Identify operations run by different gangs and rob one for every gang rather than repeatedly hitting the same group. The description implies multiple distinct gangs, so keep a list of which gangs you have already covered.
trophies.sources: Official PS5 trophy list via Exophase and PSNProfiles

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Go to Ocean Beach, find the spot offering a cocktail with a view, and use it. The description reads like a specific scenic moment, so if no prompt appears, return at a different time of day and try again rather than assuming any drink anywhere counts.
trophies.sources: Official PS5 trophy list via Exophase and PSNProfiles

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. Get into a vehicle inside a showroom and drive it out through the glass or exit in dramatic fashion. The description does not name a showroom, so try the prominent dealerships you find while exploring.
trophies.sources: Official PS5 trophy list via Exophase and PSNProfiles

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Play bowling at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley and complete your follow-through there. Visit that named alley, start a game of bowling and play it through. The wording suggests finishing the bowling activity at that specific venue, not at any alley.
trophies.sources: Official PS5 trophy list via Exophase and PSNProfiles

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: The description, 'A partnership with mass appeal,' is too vague to confirm a specific action. It most plausibly relates to a story or partner moment, so play through the campaign and partner content attentively. No location, character action or method is confirmed by the description alone, and none is invented here.
trophies.sources: Official PS5 trophy list via Exophase and PSNProfiles

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: The description refers to choices made, for better or worse, suggesting this tracks decisions you make during play. Make choices deliberately as they arise in missions and encounters rather than skipping them. The exact choices and any required total are not confirmed by the description alone, so progress it naturally through the story first.
trophies.sources: Official PS5 trophy list via Exophase and PSNProfiles

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: The description, 'Second time's the charm,' suggests succeeding at something on a second attempt after a first failure. If an activity or challenge allows a retry, fail or miss it once and then succeed on the immediate next try. The specific activity is not confirmed by the description alone, so watch for retry prompts during normal play.
trophies.sources: Official PS5 trophy list via Exophase and PSNProfiles

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: The description, 'What the hell just happened?', points to witnessing something strange or unexplained. Keep exploring unusual places and events, especially odd encounters away from main roads. The trigger is not confirmed by the description alone, so no location or event is claimed here.
trophies.sources: Official PS5 trophy list via Exophase and PSNProfiles

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Knock someone over with a melee drive-by. While driving, use a melee attack from the vehicle to bowl over a pedestrian or opponent, as the trophy name Ten Pin implies. Pick a slow, clear stretch of road so the melee swing connects cleanly.
trophies.sources: Official PS5 trophy list via Exophase and PSNProfiles

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn 250,000 dollars by laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Feed marked bills into the laundering route whenever you acquire them and keep a running total until you pass the quarter-million mark. This is a cumulative money total, so it builds naturally if you launder consistently instead of spending marked bills elsewhere.
trophies.sources: Official PS5 trophy list via Exophase and PSNProfiles

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend 100,000 dollars across all shops. Spread your spending across clothing, vehicles, weapons and other stores until the cumulative spend reaches the target. Money you were going to spend anyway counts toward it, so there is no need to waste purchases purely for this trophy.
trophies.sources: Official PS5 trophy list via Exophase and PSNProfiles

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all garage properties. Buy every garage on the property market, saving income from missions and side work until you can afford the full set. The description requires all of them, so check the property listings for any garage you have overlooked.
trophies.sources: Official PS5 trophy list via Exophase and PSNProfiles

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Whenever you acquire a new vehicle, register it through the app until ten are logged. Keep registrations current as your collection grows so this finishes well before the late game.
trophies.sources: Official PS5 trophy list via Exophase and PSNProfiles
